Greedy is below fixed by 23.2 pp at 5% and 8.8 pp at 10%, and ties at 25% and 50%. L7a repeats this at equal labels, and greedy trails by 2.1 to 3.4 pp. So the free-label confound is controlled, and the result favors the fixed rule. The prompt-space test (L2c) was never run. So there is no qualifying non-E01 kill or support, and claim 3 stays open. W2 and W3 are false.

Claim 2: G01 compares the learned greedy allocator with a label-free recal threshold at matched budgets. Both read the same verified-label stream, so the baseline has no information advantage. The gap is -25.6, -2.6, +0.9 and 0.0 pp at 5, 10, 25 and 50%, so the learned arm never beats the fixed rule. L7a, at equal labels, gives -2.06 and -3.35 pp. Claim 2 is not_supported. Claim 3: the only embedding statistics (AUC gain -0.001, neighbor ratio about 1.0) come from E01. Every later entry uses the same model, task and proxy and reports no embedding AUC. The kill condition needs a non-E01 entry on a different model, task or proxy, so it is not met. Nothing shows a gain of 0.05 or a ratio of 1.5, so claim 3 is open. The ledger concludes not_supported on claim 2 and no claim-3 support, so W2 and W3 are false.
